h1: The 8 Best Desktop Monitor Privacy Screens of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Monitor Privacy Screens: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: eight 24 inch desktop monitor privacy options, from 2-pack filters to a built-in filter monitor, compared on fit and price.
summary: The Peslv 2-pack is our pick for matched dual-monitor desks. The magnetic 2-pack suits people who toggle between private work and screen-sharing, the IPROKKO 2-pack covers mixed-brand offices, and the ViewSonic VG2448-PF skips filters with a built-in toggleable one.
intro: A privacy screen only works if it fits your monitor exactly, and the listing rarely makes that obvious. Every option here is a 24 inch, 16:9 model, so the first check is your own monitor: a mismatch in size or aspect ratio leaves gaps or a cropped view.

We reviewed eight desktop options: seven attachable filters, mostly in 2-packs, and one monitor with a built-in filter. We ranked them on the spec sheets: size, aspect ratio, attachment style and pack count. Performance claims like viewing angle are not in our data, so we do not make them.

products.name: Peslv [2-Pack] 24 Inch Privacy Screen for Computer Monitor, 16:9 Aspect Ratio
products.verdict: A removable 2-pack for matched dual-monitor desks.
products.description:
The Peslv is a 2-pack of removable 24 inch filters for 16:9 monitors, in the $50-100 bracket.

It takes first place on the strength of a removable design in a matched pair, so both screens get identical filtering. It costs more than some other 2-packs below.

Best for dual-monitor desks with identical 24 inch screens. Skip it if you have one monitor.

products.name: 2 Pack 24 Inch Magnetic Computer Privacy Screen for Monitor, 16:9 Aspect Ratio
products.verdict: Magnetic attachment for quick on and off.
products.description:
This is a 2-pack of 24 inch, 16:9 privacy screens that attach magnetically, in the $50-100 bracket.

It comes second because magnetic attachment helps people who switch between private work and screen-sharing, though the Peslv offers a matching pair at the same price. Magnets also make it easy to remove for cleaning.

Best for workstations that share screens regularly. Check what the magnets attach to on your monitor.

products.name: IPROKKO [2-Pack] 24 Inch Computer Privacy Screen Filter for 16:9 Widescreen Monitor
products.verdict: A 2-pack listed as compatible with multiple monitor brands.
products.description:
The IPROKKO is a 2-pack of 24 inch, 16:9 filters listed as multi-brand compatible, in the $25-50 bracket.

It ranks third because it halves the price bracket of the first two and works across mixed brands. The listing gives no attachment method, so check it.

Best for offices with mixed 24 inch brands. Verify the attachment style before buying.
products.skipIf: You want a stated magnetic mount.

products.name: SightPro 24 Inch 16:9 Computer Privacy Screen Filter for Monitor
products.verdict: A single 24 inch filter for one-monitor desks.
products.description:
The SightPro is a single 24 inch, 16:9 privacy filter, in the $25-50 bracket.

Fourth place reflects a lone filter instead of a pair, so it only suits single-monitor desks. For a dual setup, buying two costs more than a 2-pack.

Best for a single desktop monitor. Do not buy it for a matched pair.

products.name: Magicmoon 2-Pack 24 Inch Computer Privacy Screen Filter for 16:9 Monitor
products.description:
The Magicmoon is a 2-pack of 24 inch, 16:9 filters, in the $25-50 bracket.

It lands fifth because the listing gives no attachment or compatibility detail, while the IPROKKO at the same price lists multi-brand fit. The pair keeps cost down.

Best for budget dual-monitor setups. Read the full listing for attachment information.

products.name: [2 Pack] 24 Inch Computer Privacy Screen Filter for 16:9 Widescreen Monitor
products.verdict: A plain 2-pack of 24 inch widescreen filters.
products.description:
This is an unbranded-style 2-pack of 24 inch, 16:9 widescreen filters, in the $50-100 bracket.

It ranks sixth because it costs the same as the Peslv and magnetic packs while listing less. Nothing in the data sets it apart.

Best for buyers who find it at a good price. Compare against the Peslv before buying.

products.name: Computer Privacy Screen Filter for 24 Inch 16:9 Aspect Ratio Monitor
products.verdict: A budget single filter for one 24 inch monitor.
products.description:
This is a single 24 inch, 16:9 privacy filter, in the $25-50 bracket.

It ranks seventh because it matches the SightPro on size and price while naming less. It is the simplest buy for one screen.

Best for a budget single-monitor desk. Confirm attachment style on the listing.

products.name: ViewSonic VG2448-PF 24 Inch IPS 1080p Ergonomic Monitor with Built-In Privacy Filter
products.verdict: A monitor with a built-in toggleable privacy filter.
products.description:
The ViewSonic VG2448-PF is a 24 inch IPS 1080p monitor with a built-in, toggleable privacy filter. It has HDMI, DisplayPort and USB, and a 40-degree tilt.

It ranks last as a privacy option because it is a full monitor in the $200-500 bracket, not an add-on. It makes sense only if you also need a new screen.

Best for buyers replacing a monitor who want privacy switching built in. Existing monitor owners should buy a filter.

whatMatters.detail: Privacy filters are cut to a screen size and aspect ratio. A 24 inch 16:9 filter will not fit a 24 inch 16:10 monitor properly. Check your monitor's specs first.
Dual-monitor desks need two filters, and a 2-pack usually costs less than two singles. Count your screens before buying.
Magnetic filters come on and off quickly, useful for screen-sharing. Other designs are removable but slower. Look for the attachment method in the listing.
Some listings state multi-brand fit. That helps in mixed offices, but check bezel thickness and your model.
A monitor with a built-in filter avoids fit issues but costs far more. It only makes sense if you need a new monitor anyway.

cards.label: Add-on filter
cards.text: Fits your existing monitor at low cost. Picks: Peslv, magnetic 2-pack, IPROKKO, SightPro, Magicmoon.

cards.label: Built-in
cards.text: A toggleable filter inside a new monitor. Pick: ViewSonic VG2448-PF.

howToChoose.note: Most buyers should default to an add-on filter unless replacing the monitor.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A filter that matches your monitor size and, if sharing, an easy toggle.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The magnetic 2-pack toggles quickly, and the IPROKKO lists multi-brand compatibility.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You need a monitor too: the ViewSonic VG2448-PF has a built-in toggleable filter.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You own a 24 inch 16:9 monitor: the SightPro or IPROKKO costs $25-50.

faq.a: Only if it is 24 inch and 16:9. Check your monitor's specs against the listing.
Ignoring aspect ratio. A mismatch leaves gaps or an off-center filter.

faq.q: Is the ViewSonic worth it over a filter?
faq.a: Only if you need a new monitor. Otherwise a filter costs far less.

faq.q: How do I install a filter?
faq.a: Follow the maker's steps for the attachment style. Magnetic models are listed as magnetic.
Use a soft, dry or lightly damp cloth, avoiding harsh chemicals.
Our data does not cover brightness impact, so check owner feedback.

finalTake: The Peslv 2-pack is the best fit for a matched dual-monitor desk. The magnetic 2-pack is better for frequent toggling, and the SightPro handles one screen. Measure your monitor and confirm 24 inch 16:9 before buying.
